name: Massive Monkey 39
author: cohencoo
description: Dark rounded amber button that changes colour on hover.
howItWorks: On hover, background changes from #282936 to #FEBF00, font-size becomes 1.1rem.
combined:
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
<title>Massive Monkey 39</title>
<style>
/* Massive Monkey 39 by cohencoo — https://uiverse.io/cohencoo/massive-monkey-39 */
button {
  background: #282936;
  padding: 10px 2rem;
  outline: 2.5px solid #FEBF00;
  outline-offset: 3px;
  border: 0;
  color: white;
  font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Oxygen, Ubuntu, Cantarell, 'Open Sans', 'Helvetica Neue', sans-serif;
  font-size: 1rem;
  border-radius: 100rem;
  transition: 0.4s;
  font-weight: 600;
}

button:hover {
  outline-offset: 4.5px;
  background: #FEBF00;
  font-size: 1.1rem;
}
</style>
</head>
<body>
<button>
  Explore
</button>

</body>
</html>
